articles.summary: Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi stressed dialogue for resolving bilateral issues between India and Bangladesh. He expressed hope that Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's visit to India should occur much sooner.

articles.title: IGNOU extends July 2026 admission deadline for ODL programmes till August 31
articles.summary: IGNOU has extended the application deadline for its July 2026 Open and Distance Learning programmes to August 31. Eligible candidates can apply online through the university’s admission portal by registering, selecting a programme, uploading the required documents and completing the fee payment.

articles.title: CBSE begins phase-wise declaration of KVS, NVS Tier-II recruitment exam results; check posts covered in first phase
articles.summary: CBSE has started the phase-wise release of results for the KVS and NVS Tier-II recruitment examination 2026. Results for PGT and TGT Computer Science, Stenographer Grade-I and Finance Officer are being announced first.

articles.title: UP Board Class 10th, 12th Compartment result released at results.upmsp.edu.in: Direct link to download scorecards here
articles.summary: The UPMSP has announced the 2026 compartment results for Class 10 and 12 students, providing clarity to candidates who appeared for the supplementary examination. Students can access their marksheets online using their roll number, school code and date of birth.

articles.title: Hyderabad-born MIT astronomer Rohan Naidu helps uncover a possible ‘black hole star’ from the early universe
articles.summary: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope have identified an exceptionally bright, red object from the early universe that may be a previously unknown “black hole star”. Led by Hyderabad-born MIT astronomer Rohan Naidu, the study suggests a massive black hole could be concealed within dense hydrogen, potentially explaining the mysterious “little red dots” seen by JWST..

articles.title: 'Awarapan 2' box office collection day 4: Emraan's film crosses Rs 90 crore
articles.summary: Awarapan 2 has kicked off with an outstanding box office performance, eclipsing the entire lifetime earnings of its predecessor. With an impressive collection of Rs 22 crore on its opening day and a substantial rise over the weekend, the film's total revenue soared to Rs 91 crore during its extended opening period..

articles.title: 'Spider-Man' crosses Rs 560 crore; eyes Rs 600 crore mark in India
articles.summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day crossed Rs 560 crore gross in India on Monday. The film recorded a sharp decline in collections during its third week.

articles.title: 'Batwara 1947' box office collection day 4: Sunny Deol, Preity Zinta's film sees 72 percent drop
articles.summary: Sunny Deol's film 'Batwara 1947' experienced a sharp box office decline on its first Monday. The Partition drama earned only two crore rupees on August seventeenth.

articles.title: Kim Kardashian shares loved-up photos with Lewis Hamilton
articles.summary: Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton are openly sharing romantic photos online. The couple posted pictures from their recent summer getaway with their families.
